$comment: channels.stop -> POST calendar/v3/channels/stop, request Channel (id + resourceId), EMPTY response. The action a subscription trigger's `stop` names. Google: "If successful, this method returns an empty response body."
title: Google Calendar stop watching
description: Close a push-notification channel. The host's subscription machinery calls this before re-creating a channel and when a trigger is removed.
$sideEffectsComment: Stopping a channel that is already stopped or expired is refused with a 404 rather than doing anything twice, so a retry cannot compound -- which is what idempotent means here.

config.label: Channel ID
config.description: The channel's id, as sent to channel_watch.

config.label: Resource ID
config.description: The resourceId channel_watch answered with. Both are needed; Google refuses a stop with only one.

outputShape.description: Which estate this ran against. Google answers with an empty body, so this is the only thing published.
